I still can't confirm the exact day, month, and year of Dr. Ruit's award, so I can't give you a date. The team note about spring honors at the Thimphu Tshechu in March is a general pattern I can't verify for this award, so please don't take it as the date. Kuensel (Bhutan's national newspaper) or the Royal Secretariat's announcements would give the exact date.

CONFIDENCE: 5
